subcategory_text: System/product/service design enables data processing visibility.
implementation_examples: Design the system, product, or service to expose visibility into the data processing (e.g., view of profile data, recent activity, inferred attributes, automated decisions)
Provide the visibility through the same channels the individual already uses (in-product, web, app)
Test the visibility by user testing
assessment_objectives: Determine whether system design enables data-processing visibility
Determine whether the visibility surfaces profile data, recent activity, inferred attributes, and automated decisions
Determine whether the visibility is delivered through existing user channels
Determine whether the visibility has been validated with real users
